title: FASB Master Glossary audit data
description: Data for the note Circular, Superseded, and Borrowed: An Audit of the Definitions in the FASB Master Glossary. The note audits all 1,287 entries of the Master Glossary of the FASB Accounting Standards Codification with deterministic detectors and two independent language-model reviews, then verifies every reported defect against primary sources. The dataset holds the screening results, verification records, the glossary dependency graph and a list of paragraphs whose glossary links lead to a definition that does not apply. It contains identifiers, defect codes, verdicts and the authors' reasons, not the text of the Codification.
